plot_keypoints_2d: plot 2d keypoints overlaid on an image with optional COCO format conversion and colored skeleton connections
plot_summary_figure: create a 2x3 summary figure showing input image, joint projection, 3D mesh overlay, 3D mesh, and two alternative viewpoints
plot_keypoints_2d_coco: plot 2d keypoints in COCO format converted to HMR joint ordering overlaid on an image with colored skeleton
plot_keypoints_2d_custom_ax: plot 2d keypoints on a custom matplotlib axes with a title and optional plot display
plot_summary_figure_save: create and save a 6-panel summary figure of 3D pose results to a specified file path as jpg
